function: SDR-based joint resource allocation minimizing energy in IRS-aided NOMA wireless-powered FL
note: The resource allocation is solved by SDR with two-dimensional search or bisection, and federated learning is only the application served, with digital NOMA uploads rather than over-the-air aggregation.

function: Wavelet scattering network with federated differential privacy for RF fingerprint identification
note: The learned method performs RF fingerprint identification for device access, an excluded function, and its federated aggregation over edge and cloud nodes is digital rather than over the air.

function: Deep learning RF fingerprint identification for device access in RIS-assisted AIoT
note: The only learned component is RF fingerprint identification, an excluded function, while the RIS-assisted green transmission is handled by a hybrid quantum-classical optimization algorithm rather than a learned method.

function: Lightweight RL minimizing UAV flight distance and vehicle count for package delivery
note: The learning plans UAV flights and vehicle allocation for ground-air package delivery, a trajectory and logistics decision above the physical layer with no radio resource control.

function: DDPG optimizing UAV trajectory for UAV-assisted edge task offloading
note: Only the UAV trajectory is learned with DDPG, while resource allocation uses convex optimization and the offloading decision uses particle swarm optimization, so the learning is above the physical layer.

function: Diffusion model generating relay selection for AAV digital twin synchronization in SAGIN
note: The diffusion model only generates integer relay selection decisions (base station or satellite), an association choice above the physical layer, while the continuous resources come from conventional model-based optimization.

function: Robust multi-agent DDPG for UAV relocation, task allocation, and system recovery
note: The learning decides UAV relocation and task allocation for resilient IoRT data collection, which are placement and task decisions above the physical layer.

function: Reviews multimodal sensing-assisted V2X communication research, datasets, and simulators
note: The record is a review of multimodal sensing for V2X communication rather than a proposed and evaluated method.

function: Closed-form and BCD resource allocation for UAV swarm multi-task federated learning
note: Transmit power, computation frequency, bandwidth, and associations are optimized with closed-form solutions, block coordinate descent, and a two-stage algorithm, while the federated model is only the application and is aggregated digitally.

function: Gradient-descent SIM phase design emulating 2D DFT for DOA estimation
note: The SIM phase shifts are fitted to a 2D DFT matrix by an iterative gradient-descent optimization, not trained on data, and the task is direction-of-arrival estimation alone.

function: DRL plans adversarial UAV trajectory; SCA allocates secure ISAC network resources
note: The only learned decision is the trajectory of the malicious UAV, while the ISAC resource allocation of the legitimate network is solved by successive convex approximation.

function: CNN reconstructs RIS received signals; transfer-learned DenseNet localizes users
note: Both learned modules serve RIS-aided user localization, an excluded function, and the reconstruction of RIS signals is evaluated only through localization accuracy.

function: CNN extracts RF fingerprints from OTFS signals for emitter identification
note: Emitter identification by RF fingerprinting is an excluded function even though the signals are OTFS-modulated, and no delay-Doppler channel estimation or detection is learned.

function: CNN with residual, attention, and GLU blocks estimates carrier frequency offset
note: Carrier frequency offset estimation without channel estimation or detection is synchronization alone, an excluded function.

function: Prompt Decision Transformer plans UAV trajectory and user scheduling minimizing AoI
note: Trajectory and user scheduling are listed as above the physical layer, but scheduling ground users over the time slots of a UAV link may count as aerial-link time-slot allocation, so the full text should decide.

function: GMD-GAMP sparse Bayesian learning algorithm for OTFS channel estimation
note: Sparse Bayesian learning here is an iterative message-passing Bayesian estimator run on each received frame, not a method trained on data.

function: Deep learning estimates RIS angles of departure for 3D localization and synchronization
note: The learned angle-of-departure estimator serves user localization and clock synchronization, which are excluded functions.

function: DNN predicts secrecy outage probability of UAV-IRS NOMA with friendly jamming
note: The DNN only predicts a performance metric in place of Monte Carlo simulation and the power allocation comes from a non-learned algorithm, so no learned method performs one of the seven functions.

function: DQN selects user-satellite handover to limit feeder-user link interference
note: The learned decision is handover (user-satellite assignment), which is above the physical layer and is not satellite power, resource, or beam control.

function: Surveys federated learning in RIS, STAR-RIS, and BD-RIS networks
note: The record is a survey that classifies existing work rather than proposing and evaluating a method.

function: Surveys RIS-assisted SWIPT architectures and optimization methods for IoT
note: The record is a survey of RIS-assisted SWIPT systems rather than a proposed and evaluated method.

function: Lagrange dual decomposition and SQP for SAGIN association, spectrum, UAV deployment
note: The method uses Lagrange dual decomposition and sequential quadratic programming, and deep reinforcement learning appears only as a benchmark.

function: Adversarial multi-agent RL for secure offloading and resource allocation in UAV-MEC
note: Offloading is above the physical layer, but the learned resource allocation for secure links to the UAVs is unspecified and may include transmit power or bandwidth, which the aerial-link exception counts as physical layer.

function: Diffusion-enhanced MADDPG for UAV task offloading and resource allocation in rescue
note: Task assignment and exploration are above the physical layer, but the abstract does not say whether the learned resource allocation covers only computing or also bandwidth or power of the UAV-to-ground and UAV-to-airship links.

function: Clustering selects true DOA among ambiguous candidates in hybrid massive MIMO
note: The learned clustering resolves phase ambiguity for direction-of-arrival estimation alone, an excluded function.

function: Bayesian-optimized LSTM predicts user location in RIS-assisted communications
note: The learned model performs user localization, an excluded function, and the power allocation that supports data collection is not learned.

function: Inverse soft-Q learning for multi-IRS user association in UAV communications
note: Only the IRS-user association is learned, which sits between user association above the physical layer and allocation of RIS reflecting resources in a UAV link, while trajectory, SIC order, and power use SCA and Dinkelbach.

function: Mixture-Gaussian RL selects satellites and transmit power for inter-satellite localization
note: Although the RL controls satellite transmit power, it serves passive localization of a target satellite, a positioning function outside the seven areas, not a communication link.
